import json
import sys
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
manifest = tomllib.loads((root / 'Cargo.toml').read_text())
edition = str(manifest['workspace']['package']['edition'])
candidates = []
for target in manifest['bin']:
    path = root / target['path']
    readable = path.is_file()
    candidates.append({'name': target['name'], 'kind': 'bin', 'source_path': str(path) if readable else '', 'edition': edition, 'source_failure_display': None if readable else str(path)})
lib = root / 'src/lib.rs'
readable = lib.is_file()
candidates.append({'name': manifest['package']['name'], 'kind': 'lib', 'source_path': str(lib) if readable else '', 'edition': edition, 'source_failure_display': None if readable else str(lib)})
assert not (root / 'scripts').exists(), 'captured source must continue excluding scripts'
assert all(item['source_failure_display'] is None for item in candidates), candidates
json.dump(candidates, sys.stdout)
sys.stdout.write('\n')
